items.title: Broadcom Has Taken a Haircut Over 3 Months: One Analyst Expects 72% Returns From Here
items.summary: Broadcom has quietly slipped while the rest of the AI chip complex surged, leaving it as the only major name trading at a steep discount to analyst consensus. The question now is whether that gap closes upward or the bears finally find their footing.
